Blacktop Package — includes Gloss Black badging, 20-in. Dark Finish wheels, Eclipse Black exhaust tips, Satin Black Dodge taillamp badge, black roof rails, integrated roof tail crossbars, all-season Pirelli tires

Blacktop Redline Package — includes Gloss black badging, Satin Black Dodge taillamp badge, front and rear SRT spoilers, GT decklid decal with red tracer, leather/Alcantara SRT performance seats with red accent stitching, laser- etched “Crypto Sweep” interior inlays, premium leather-wrapped door panels/IP/console, second- row fold/tumble captain chairs, all-season Pirelli tires
Mopar All-weather Package — includes slush mats, front and rear door sill guards and cargo net
Mopar Black Tubular Side Steps

Plus Package GT (V-6) — includes power sunroof, Advanced Brake Assist, rain- sensing windshield wipers, Lane Departure Warning, Alpine premium audio with nine speakers and subwoofer, LED aux low beam, LED amber turn signal, Nappa leather seats, 12-way power driver and passenger seats, power tilt/telescoping column, heated first- and second row seats, vented first-row seats, memory settings, adaptive cruise control, wireless Apple CarPlay, wireless Android Auto, Trailer-tow Group, and Blind-spot Monitoring with Trailer Detect

Plus Package GT HEMI — includes power sunroof, automatic headlamp control, Nappa leather seats, leather-wrapped door panels, eight-way power driver and passenger seats with four-way power lumbar, power tilt/telescoping column, heated first- and second-row seats, auto dim exterior driver-side mirror, vented first-row seats, black roof rails, integrated roof rail crossbars, memory settings, adaptive cruise control, Trailer-tow Group, Forward Collision Warning Plus

Premium Package GT HEMI (content adds to Plus Package) — includes Advanced Brake Assist, Lane Departure Warning Plus, Harman Kardon 19- speaker system, premium leather-wrapped door panel, instrument panel and console, suede headliner, forged carbon-fiber interior accents, bright cargo area scuff pads

Premium Package R/T 392 Launch Edition (content adds to R/T 392 Launch Edition model) — includes Trailer Tow, two-piece rotor Brembo brakes, adaptive cruise control, Advanced Brake Assist, Lane Departure Warning Plus, automatic emergency braking, Harman Kardon 19- speaker system, sunroof, premium leather-wrapped door panel/instrument panel/console, suede headliner, forged carbon- fiber interior accents, bright cargo area scuff pads, auto high-beam headlamps
Second-row Fold/Tumble Captain Chairs (requires GT HEMI Plus or Premium) — includes second-row mini-console with cupholders, six-passenger seating

Tow N Go Package — includes 20-in. SRT Satin Carbon wheels (20-in. SRT Lights Out wheels and SRT Black exhaust tips with Blacktop or Blacktop Redline Package), high-performance exhaust, widebody flares, black Brembo brake calipers, Bilstein adaptive damping high-performance suspension, electronic limited slip rear axle, Pirelli Scorpion Zero Run-Flat 295 tires, hard-button Drive Modes, Class IV trailer hitch (8,700 lbs.), integrated trailer brake controller, active noise cancelling, automatic headlamp leveling

Trailer-tow Group IV (included with GT Plus, R/T Plus and Premium Packages) — includes integrated trailer brake controller, HD cooling (standard on SRT), rear-load leveling suspension, full-size spare (compact on SRT), Class IV receiver hitch, Blind-spot with Trailer Detection, two-speed transfer case
